{{Vanilla|Iron Ore}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Hematite''' is the pack's name for iron ore.

The deepslate variant is '''deepslate hematite'''.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
As vanilla iron ore.

=== Breaking ===
Mined with a pickaxe (see [[Tools#Mining levels]]), hematite drops 1 raw iron, affected by [[Fortune]] and the [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] intrinsic.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/iron_ore.json}}</ref> Deepslate hematite drops 2 raw iron, with the same bonuses.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/deepslate_iron_ore.json}}</ref> Tools with the adamant intrinsic drop iron ingots instead (1 from hematite, 2 from deepslate hematite), with the same Fortune and electrum bonuses. Silk Touch drops the block.

{{Upcoming|the 26.3 port}}
In the 1.12.3 alpha for 26.3, and in the 26.3 port, deepslate hematite drops 1 raw iron like hematite, and adamant tools get 1 to 2 ingots from it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/deepslate_iron_ore.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref>
